arbitrations.sourceText: delta-radiomics avant et pendant RT pour toxicité pulmonaire tardive
arbitrations.reason: The phrase 'pour toxicité pulmonaire tardive' does not explicitly ground a predictive relation.

changes.justification: The new relation preserves a source-grounded candidate association without adding predictive force.

arbitrations.sourceText: Faut-il regarder l'œdème ou la MVO pour expliquer le no-reflow, sans dire que l'un cause l'autre ?
arbitrations.reason: The legacy taxonomy forces an artificial reduction between phenomenon, observable property and biomarker role.

arbitrations.sourceText: pseudoprogression vs récidive: perfusion DSC + spectro, résultat histologique pas toujours dispo
arbitrations.reason: The source grounds comparison, while COMPARATOR is a study role and must not replace the ontological CONDITION type.

changes.justification: The recurrence remains a condition; its comparator function remains a contextual role.
The lexical source 'vs' demonstrates comparison, not the stronger distinction relation.

arbitrations.sourceText: Deux agents K-edge injectés pour séparer inflammation et vascularisation : projet exploratoire.
arbitrations.reason: An injected agent is an intervention/exposure in the legacy operational model; inflammation and vascularisation are phenomena/targets.

changes.justification: The source explicitly describes injected agents, not a measurement technique.
Inflammation is the targeted phenomenon in the stated exploratory design.
Vascularisation is the targeted phenomenon in the stated exploratory design.

arbitrations.sourceText: Mesurer perfusion rénale et prédire déclin du DFG; ASL maintenant, suivi deux ans.
arbitrations.reason: PD-003 V2 already separates ObservableProperty, MeasurementDefinition and BiomarkerRole; the legacy SEM model cannot fully represent that separation.

arbitrations.sourceText: Comparer deux parcours de consentement et mesurer le taux de refus dans quatre centres.
arbitrations.reason: Measuring a refusal rate does not express an intention to modify it. The ENDPOINT/OUTCOME legacy mapping remains unresolved and is not forced in this mission.

changes.before: deux parcours de consentement AIMS_TO_MODIFY taux de refus
changes.justification: The relation is removed because it is not source-grounded.
